Test vector: Invalid transcript signature, signature from wrong key, wrong session ID, wrong generation
Required ingress outcome: Reject before capability lookup or dispatch

Test vector: Signed frame modified after authentication, altered capability commitment, altered policy version
Payload exceeds max_frame_bytes; length prefix exceeds configured bound
Object contains a field not named in the schema
Same structural field appears twice, such as two operation or two expires_at fields
Equivalent semantic object encoded in noncanonical key order, alternate integer encoding, invalid UTF-8, surplus padding
Supported session receives older or unsupported protocol/schema version
Required ingress outcome: Reject; no fallback to weaker parser or policy

Test vector: Two independently implemented decoders disagree on acceptance, decoded AST, or canonical bytes
Required ingress outcome: Reject test corpus; block release until parity restored

Test vector: Reused sequence, nonce, replay-cache commitment, or old generation
Required ingress outcome: Reject and terminate active external authority

Test vector: Add admin, raw_memory, config_write, firmware_update, or undeclared data category
Required ingress outcome: Reject unknown operation or capability mismatch

Test vector: Add fields that map to internal session state or capability properties
Required ingress outcome: Reject unknown/duplicate fields and prohibit deserializing directly into internal structs

Test vector: Frame flood, deeply nested structure, oversized strings, invalid-signature storm
Required ingress outcome: Rate limit, bounded parsing, aggregate audit receipt
Protected-service proof: Protected service receives only admitted bounded frames

Test vector: Sender disputes a rejection or teardown
Protected-service proof: Receipt does not contain raw payload

Test vector: Malformed frame attempts to trigger verbose error or debug dump
Required ingress outcome: Return bounded error class; redact logs
Protected-service proof: No payload, key, capability, or private policy dump
